title: kcapi_aead_decrypt: pr_err on every AEAD auth failure is wrong
description: The old kcapi_aead_decrypt checked ret == -EBADMSG separately from ret < 0. The new code collapses both into a single if (ret) branch that calls pr_err_ratelimited before going to the same out_free_req label. Functional behavior (goto destination) is unchanged, but pr_err is now emitted on every authentication failure. AEAD authentication failures (-EBADMSG) are a normal security event under replay attacks or corrupt data — not a kernel error. A ratelimited pr_err will appear in dmesg on every failing decryption attempt up to the ratelimit, making dmesg noisy and potentially masking real errors. Trigger: any AEAD decryption with wrong key or tampered ciphertext. Bad behavior: pr_err floods dmesg with 'crypto_aead_decrypt returned -74' messages.
